decisions.text: Official OpenCode v2 verified: POST /api/session/:id/prompt files[] forwards PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, PDF, UTF-8 text & dirs to LLM (20 MiB max); non-native/large files upload via POST /api/experimental/fs/write to <tmp>/uploads/<uuid>/<name> + Attached file ref + metadata.attachments; timeline uses thumbnail+lightbox for images and AttachmentCard for files (supports experimental-media-uri media:<hash>). No native audio LLM forwarding or geographic location schema in OpenCode v2.

Owner decisions: (1) Location = geographic GPS/coordinates pin in composer + clickable map card in timeline opening maps app; (2) Audio = pick audio files via + button + inline audio player card in timeline (play/pause + scrubber, add Flutter audio player plugin); (3) Files/PDF/upload = follow official OpenCode app completely: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, PDF (lifting old ROADMAP restriction when model supports PDF), UTF-8 text inline; other files/audio/>20MiB via temp upload POST /api/experimental/fs/write (<tmp>/uploads/<uuid>/<name>) + path ref + metadata.attachments.
